narrative: 时间仿佛围绕着一个吻、一处威胁，或一件产品坍缩了。与摇镜头不同，摄影机会揭示主体的不同侧面，并不断改变它与每一面墙之间的关系。
完整的一圈环绕会把注意力引向空间本身；部分弧线则可以更为低调。如果你只需要一个四分之一转来改变对话的轴线，或者是主体在转盘上旋转而摄影机静止不动，那么这就不是合适的工具。
要把实时速度的环绕与同样操纵时间的子弹时间（Bullet Time）区分开来。
how: 铺设一条圆形路径，确定一个中心点，随着距离的呼吸式变化协调好对焦。除非同时做升降运动，否则保持高度一致。
环绕过程中不要变焦，除非你想要的是另一种技巧。提示词：完整的360度环绕，恒定半径，始终面向主体，背景如一条光带般环绕流转。
when: 当一个瞬间应该围绕一个人合拢时使用：一个吻、一处威胁，或一件主打产品。具体场景：一对情侣接吻，房间变成了一条流转的光带。
不要同时变焦，也不要让主体本身旋转来代替摄影机的运动。
vs: 左弧形运镜（Arc Left）和右弧形运镜（Arc Right）是部分环绕，通常约90度，用于改变轴线，而不是制造奇观。转盘拍摄（Lazy Susan）则是让物体本身旋转，摄影机可以保持不动。
摇镜头从不改变支撑装置的位置。360°环绕则是沿一整圈方位角进行的完整审视。
examples_film: 《黑客帝国》（The Matrix）在天台的子弹时间段落中环绕悬停的动作：这是环绕加时间操纵的组合，要注意区分。《迷魂记》（Vertigo）环绕斯科蒂和朱迪，让记忆中的场景浮现。
《卡里托之路》（Carlito's Way）和《美国丽人》（American Beauty）用实时速度的环绕来表现陷阱感或迷醉感。要学的是圆周运动的语法，而不是照搬其中的服装。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是主体原地旋转，或者三脚架上的向左摇。破绽在于背景固定不动而身体在旋转，或者根本没有视差。
解决办法：摄影机沿圆周移动，主体大体保持不动，背景环绕流转，半径保持恒定。

faq.q: 电影中的360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）是什么？
faq.a: 它是摄影机沿一条完整圆周路径环绕主体的运动，通常以恒定距离面向主体，使各个侧面和背景中的每一面墙都依次呈现。

faq.q: 360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）与弧形运镜（Arc Shot）的区别
faq.a: 弧形运镜是一段部分弧线，通常是一个四分之一转，用来改变轴线。360°环绕则完成一整个圆周，让空间本身成为事件。

faq.q: 什么时候该用360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）？
faq.a: 当一个吻、一处威胁，或一件主打道具应该主宰时间时使用。如果90度的弧形运动就足够，不要用完整的一圈环绕。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：摄影机围绕[Subject]做360度环绕，恒定半径，始终面向主体，背景环绕流转。禁止让主体在转盘上旋转，禁止额外变焦。

narrative: Time can feel as if it collapsed around one kiss, one threat, or one product. Unlike a pan, the camera reveals different sides of the subject and changes their relation to every wall.

A full orbit calls attention to space itself; a partial arc can be quieter. It is the wrong tool when you only needed a quarter-turn to change a conversation axis, and the wrong tool if the subject is spinning on a turntable while the camera sits still.
Separate live-speed orbiting from bullet time, which also manipulates time.
how: Lay a circular path, pick a center, coordinate focus as distance breathes. Keep height even unless you also boom.
Do not zoom during the orbit unless you want a different technique. Prompt a full 360-degree orbit, constant radius, always facing the subject, background wrapping as a ribbon of light.
when: Use it when a moment should close around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. Concrete beat: a couple kisses while the room becomes a ribbon.
Do not also zoom, and do not let the subject rotate instead of the camera.
vs: Arc Left and Arc Right are partial orbits, often about 90 degrees, for axis change rather than spectacle. A Lazy Susan turns the object while the camera may stay put.
A pan never relocates the support. Orbit 360 is a full inspection on an azimuth circle.
examples_film: The Matrix circles suspended action in the rooftop bullet-time sequence: orbit plus time manipulation, so keep the distinction. Vertigo circles Scottie and Judy as the remembered setting appears.
Carlito's Way and American Beauty use live-speed orbits as trap or rapture. Grammar of the circle, not a costume to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a subject rotating on the spot, or a Pan Left from sticks. The tell is a fixed background with a spinning body, or no parallax.
The fix: camera travels a circle, subject mostly still, background wrapping, constant radius.

faq.a: It is a camera path that circles a subject all the way around, usually facing them at a steady distance, so every side and every background wall appears.
An arc is a partial curve, often a quarter-turn to change axis. A 360 orbit completes the circle and makes space itself the event.
When a kiss, a threat, or a hero object should own time. Do not use a full spin if a 90-degree arc would do.

faq.q: How do I prompt 360-Degree Orbit for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write camera orbits 360 degrees around [Subject], constant radius, always facing them, background wrapping. Ban a turntable subject and ban extra zoom.
